headline: Chipmakers boom: SK Hynix record listing, TSMC record quarter
body: A quiet day. SK Hynix made a record Nasdaq debut to fund new fabs, and TSMC posted record quarterly revenue of about $39.6 billion on AI chip demand. Both add to Capability Velocity, lifting Enslaved God, Descendants and Zookeeper and pushing Reversion down. Horizon Balance: +1.76.
movers_note: Reversion -0.1, from TSMC's record revenue (-0.08) and SK Hynix's Nasdaq debut (-0.04). Descendants +0.08, from TSMC's record revenue (+0.08) and SK Hynix's Nasdaq debut (+0.04), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05). Enslaved God +0.07, from TSMC's record revenue (+0.08) and SK Hynix's Nasdaq debut (+0.04), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05).
